snippet.title: Tidy Bakery - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Take over your grandpa's messy bakery and sort thousands of pastries in Tidy Bakery, a cozy tidying sim with no timers and no way to fail. Coming to Steam in December 2026.

👉 add it to your wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5322140/Tidy_Bakery/

🎮 main channel: https://www.youtube.com/@explorerdotgames

🌐 other platforms: https://beacons.ai/explorer.games

#TidyBakery #CozyGame #TidyingGame
